source.description: Online-Mind2Web task file as vendored by BrowserOS (packages/browseros-agent/apps/eval/data/mind2web.jsonl)

online_mind2web_hard.jsonl.role: primary evaluation set (E1 and the ablation subset are drawn from here)

online_mind2web_all.jsonl.role: all 300 tasks (easy/medium/hard) + workbook annotations; use with --tasks filters

task_catalog.json.role: per-task annotations (category, antibot_risk, attention_level) and third-party run/human labels

notes: The paper draft reported 'Mind2Web Hard (66 tasks)'. This frozen copy has 74 hard tasks and no per-task record of the 66-task run exists in the repository. Reconciling the two (which tasks, which exclusions) is a user-owned follow-up tracked in eval/benchmarks/exclusions.json; E0 reports the discrepancy explicitly.
Task ids are the upstream query_id (md5-like hex). Instructions are verbatim; start_url is the benchmark's starting page.

annotations_source.also_contains: one third-party system's per-task pass/fail and six annotators' human labels OF THAT SYSTEM's runs; recorded under task_catalog 'external' and never used as a SuperBrowser result
